name: mf-tgca-scope-and-compliance
description: French Saint-Martin TGCA reference for businesses supplying goods and services, using the territorial tax code consolidated through June 2026. Covers local supply tests, imports, documented stock purchases, the Dutch-side export exclusion, ordinary and qualifying housing rates, collection timing, registration and periodic returns. Includes mechanical calculation examples and annual-tax filing boundaries. Distinguishes French Saint-Martin from Sint Maarten and identifies foreign-supplier registration evidence. Sector exemptions, special taxable bases, penalties and later amendments require separate verification before filing. This source-cited draft is not comprehensive country coverage or professional attestation.
